title: Incentives for Companies to Extend Flexible Working Arrangements to Outsourced Workers
what_it_is: Incentives for Companies to Extend Flexible Working Arrangements to Outsourced Workers

sections.label: Work-Life Grant ceased
sections.summary: Contractors doing outsourced work could apply for the Work-Life Grant, which ceased in August 2020 as flexible work arrangements became more common.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Contractors that performed outsourced work for their clients could apply for the Work-Life Grant.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Since the start of the COVID-19 pandemic, many forms of FWAs, such as telecommuting and staggered working hours, have become more common.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: With FWAs becoming increasingly prevalent, the Work-Life Grant was ceased in August 2020.

sections.label: Outsourcing double hurdle for FWAs
sections.summary: Outsourcing creates a double hurdle for those in flexible work arrangements, raising the question of how to stop companies and contractors passing the buck.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: There is a supplementary question here where we keep on asking ourselves.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: This whole idea of outsourcing creates what we call a double hurdle for those who are in FWAs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: Because the contractor must be willing to provide FWAs in the first place, and then the outsourcing business must have workflows and preferences that can make it feasible for the contractor to provide FWAs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: How do we ensure that companies and contractors do not pass the buck to one another?

sections.label: Tripartite effort on flexible work
sections.summary: Flexible work arrangements are challenging for production line workers, but a tripartite effort and an Alliance for Action on Work Life Harmony encourage adoption and job redesign.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: It is quite a challenge to do flexible work arrangements when the worker is required to man a production line, for example.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: But having said that, there is a tripartite effort to encourage outsourced companies to do a lot more flexible work arrangements where possible.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: There is also an Alliance for Action on Work Life Harmony, which is a good example of how the partners can come together to look at ways in which they can encourage, not just companies, but also workers, to adopt new skills, so that there is a lot more upgrading and redesign of the jobs.
